title: Shelfwise
summary: Stock forecasting dashboard that tells small grocery stores what to reorder before the weekly delivery.

data.text: Brindlecart supplies independent grocery stores. Store managers ordered stock from memory, which meant empty shelves on Fridays and wasted fresh produce on Mondays.
Odile built Shelfwise, a Next.js dashboard that turns till data into a short reorder list per supplier, with a confidence band so managers can see when the forecast is a guess.

data.alt: Shelfwise reorder list with forecast bands
data.caption: Each line shows the suggested quantity and how sure the model is.

data.text: The hardest part was trust: early versions were accurate but ignored. Adding a plain sentence explaining each suggestion ("sold 14 last week, a bank holiday is coming") doubled the number of suggestions accepted.
